finalText:
The build finishes with exit code 0 now.

Two real bugs caused the build to fail, both from the dependency bump:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but the code still read `options.retries`, which is `undefined`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict check only accepted `true` or `false` and threw on anything else. Added an `undefined` case that treats it as disabled.

The rest of the console output (8 warnings) is deprecation noise from the bump — `fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, sync loader hooks, `punycode`, `module.parent` — not build-breaking. Let me know if you want those cleaned up too, since they are unrelated to the crash.
